speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise while pregnant; to begin our assessment, how many weeks pregnant are you and have you had any recent travel or contact with sick individuals?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. Since your symptoms began shortly after eating ice cream, did you have any undercooked meat, unpasteurized dairy products, or raw vegetables associated with that meal? I also need to know if you have had any contact with cattle or cats recently.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeria Monocytogenes Infection (Listeriosis).

The combination of sudden fever, headache, and malaise in a 30-week pregnant woman who consumed ice cream three days prior is highly characteristic of listeriosis from unpasteurized dairy products. Given your gestational age and symptoms, we must treat this as a medical emergency. Please proceed immediately to the delivery room for antibiotic initiation and fetal monitoring.
